rule: Re-read root README.md and latest upstream skills/urban-design-ai-submission/SKILL.md at the start of every continuation session.
design_headline: City as an urban operating system that converts AI into tested public capability
spatial_headline: Capability Backbone plus distributed learning units
reason_canonical_files_not_modified_yet: The previous validated package is preserved until current upstream rules, source registry, organizer geometry, schema IDs, baseline geometry, metrics and matrices are revalidated. The new narrative must not silently break a validated machine-readable package.
next_required_actions: Record latest upstream commit and current baseline commit used for audit.
Re-read current organizer geometry and determine official vs provisional status.
Re-read current schema / compliance / standard / design-depth IDs.
Run the untouched baseline through the latest self-check / preflight workflow if possible.
Convert the spatial_system_spec into permitted geometry changes only after the evidence gate passes.
Add custom metric definitions to canonical metrics using exact current schema; do not invent current UAR value.
Migrate 12 scenarios, 8 personas and 6 ecosystem cases into the formal proposal / matrices / sources as required.
Insert valid source / standard / depth / data / metric references into proposal_vnext_draft.
Decide one final Chinese and English project name after spatial / VI integration.
Regenerate the five required figures from final machine-readable data.
Regenerate proposal HTML, visual HTML, A3 and A0 outputs.
Run finalize, self-check, participant preflight and CI; repair until PASS or only documented non-blocking organizer data gaps remain.

For any upstream PR, ensure the final branch modifies only the allowed submissions/<login>/<slug>/ path according to the latest Skill. Do not send workstreams/ to upstream as part of the formal submission PR.
do_not: Do not overwrite the historical validated baseline before audit.
Do not call provisional geometry an official redline.
Do not invent statutory FAR, height, density, green ratio, road redline, ownership or heritage controls.
Do not claim a named institution has committed to Public Stewardship unless a formal source supports it.
Do not present illustrative city version years as committed implementation schedules.
Do not treat Legible AI as a competing main concept; retain it only as a transparency / information-design layer if useful.
Do not optimize visuals before geometry, metrics and matrices are consistent.
